verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says Guided Reviews "break diffs into focused sections with explainers on what changed and why," which matches the story almost word for word. Related docs show code review happens inside Linear alongside Linear Agent. The support rests on a single brief changelog line. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the explainers are AI-generated, in-depth documentation of how Guided Reviews works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
